body:
CHIEF ASSESSMENT AND PRIORITY — recall-to-video mapping, 2026-08-31, current main e584ad6.

TARGET. Given an admitted video edition and a recall transcript, produce an auditable sparse mapping from ordered recall units to narrative nodes on that edition timeline. Publish GraphHsmm posterior mass P, transition flow F, fidelity and external modes, Viterbi only as a summary, exact evidence and identities, explicit unresolved or Unranked mass, a typed result bundle, and a locally openable uncertainty visualization. The output is a structured deformation of a narrative, not text similarity and not correct/incorrect labels.

WHAT IS REAL NOW. The portable source, recall, and align contracts are substantial. Source hierarchy, contexts, typed relation layers, recall functions and uncertainty, sparse multilevel candidates, faithful/distorted/external states, GraphHsmm forward-backward P and F, traces, and RecallSignature exist. On exact main, WorkedExampleSuite passes 24/24 and the raw source/recall NarrativeCompilerVerticalSuite passes 1/1. The latter is mechanical reachability only: its deterministic fixture provider recognizes a narrow rule, not arbitrary language. A local ONNX MiniLM channel is landed and has a diagnostic WOG comparison, but it is not calibrated evidence of production quality: strict recall at 1 is unchanged in that report, MRR improves, distortion anchor detection improves while facet correctness worsens, and structural chart coverage is zero on that fixture.

THE PRODUCT DOES NOT YET EXIST. Current SourceView is text-bound by SpanSet and textLength. SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, AxisIntervalSet, EvidenceSupport, and NarrativeSourceAtlas are still document-only architecture. No current CLI accepts video plus recall. No unattended provider constructs proposition-backed narrative attempts for arbitrary text or annotations; Stage 1b remains open. No lawful exact film plus human-recall pair is admitted. HsmmConfig, local-cost weights, external floor, and transition preferences are provisional and uncalibrated. Therefore current P is model-relative posterior mass under declared costs, not an empirically calibrated probability. The view module does not lower HsmmResult, AlignmentMatrix, or TransitionFlow into a recall mapping report. Current output work is source-model oriented and off-tree or pending. Automatic narrative construction and source-side uncertainty remain programme work.

CRITICAL ORDER. Preserve the accepted plan gates rather than pretending the final vertical is already authorized:

1. Recover V12 lawfully as a fresh candidate and supersede the blocked V11 row without rewriting history. Exact successor commit 36051f6 over e584ad6 has the accepted two blobs and is being registered now.
2. Repair and land the Stage 1b provider-parser contract blocker: ParserBatchResult must bind each attempt receipt to the exact input checksum, not only a caller-selected request id. Then execute a real provider and report coverage and abstention, not just contract reachability.
3. Resolve B0 with an exact admitted source-film plus recall pair. Sherlock annotation licence and human-recall REB or redistribution are owner dispositions; no agent may infer them. A public-domain or locally admitted film plus synthetic recall may serve as a mechanical court, never as scientific validation.
4. Implement C1 portable edition-axis and heterogeneous evidence contracts, then the decoder-free annotation adapter and text-seam migration. Runtime decoder observation remains E0 and needs separately admitted components.
5. Run the first end-to-end film plus recall court through the existing GraphHsmm and bundle P, F, modes, traces, receipts, and refusals.
6. Lower that result into the canonical self-contained static HTML/CSS report. Show posterior breadth, transition flow and backward returns, hierarchy level, distortion facets, external and Unranked mass, exact time/text evidence, support and missingness; never encode meaning by colour alone.
7. Calibrate and evaluate on held-out stories. Freeze estimands before seeing the corpus; compare lexical, TF-IDF, ONNX, structural, and multimodal channels; run modality ablations; measure candidate recall, anchoring and facet errors, route and transition error, posterior calibration, abstention, and failure coverage. Bind every claim to provider, geometry, config, source edition, corpus split, and exact SHA.

PARALLEL WORK AUTHORIZED. The V12 recovery, reference-scope repair, frozen calibration court, output S1-S4 contracts, and a recall-alignment view acceptance packet can proceed in parallel. C1 implementation itself remains behind P1 and B0. Full testAll courts stay serialized under the chief.

QUALITY BAR. “Excellent” will mean held-out evidence beats declared lexical baselines on pre-registered estimands without degrading distortion facets or abstention honesty; probability language is withheld until calibrated; source and recall uncertainty survive into the output; every displayed mark has a textual twin and exact evidence trace; and rerunning the same admitted inputs and fingerprints reproduces identities and values. Until then, label results diagnostic or model-relative.

IMMEDIATE ROUTING. Scout is registering the V12 successor, then owns the bounded reference-scope repair. codex-storymodel-collab is requested to freeze the calibration court after its current review. codex-storymodel4s-collab is requested to reproduce and prepare the exact Stage 1b checksum successor after its current probe reviews, sequencing around the tooling path. The stale output vertical-slice session has been asked to renew with exact status or hand off; its expired reservation will not be bypassed silently.
